took_what: Built the dose/fractionation/BED/local-control-duration table the ledger item and the RT-MDT-LUNG concept paper's own SS8(b) called for, directly in research/literature/emc-rt-lung-mets-findings.json (new 'dose_outcome_table' field), using only evidence already retrieved into that artifact -- no new fetch dispatched. Of four independently-sourced reported EMC-metastasis radiotherapy deliveries, exactly one (PMID 35494187, HDR interstitial brachytherapy, 30 Gy/2 fractions) had dose and fractionation specific enough to compute a BED: 142.5 Gy at alpha/beta=4 (arithmetic performed in this cycle, not read from any source). That figure lands almost exactly on the 2025 review's (PMID 41055792) own headline '142 Gy (alpha/beta=4)' HDR-ISBT figure -- which the review's quoted passage does not attribute to a PMID, so identifying that the review's central BED number IS this case is the one piece of new synthesis this pass produced. DECISION recorded in the artifact: the table does not surface anything the review has not already said, and remains too data-poor (3 of 4 sourced cases lack a reportable dose in what has been read so far) to support even the weaker 'descriptive appendix' framing the concept paper allowed for -- confirming, more sharply than before, that document's existing recommendation not to write this as a standalone paper (research/manuscripts/care-delivery/emc-oligometastatic-rt-concept.md SS9). A fifth candidate case (40 Gy/10 fractions SBRT) was excluded outright from the table rather than tabulated, because this artifact's own prior note flags its attribution as disputed (the review cites two conflicting primary authors for the same case).
